```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(stats)

rztpoilog <- function(n, mean, var, verbose = FALSE) {
  
  # 1. Moment Calculation Logic
  # We need to solve for mu and sigma such that the theoretical ZT moments match inputs.
  obj_fun <- function(par) {
    mu <- par[1]
    sigma <- par[2]
    
    # Validation: sigma must be positive
    if (sigma <= 0) return(1e9)
    
    # Calculate p0 (Probability of zero) via numerical integration
    # Integral of: P(Y=0 | lambda) * PDF(lambda)
    # P(Y=0 | lambda) = exp(-lambda) = exp(-exp(x)) where x is normal
    p0_res <- tryCatch(
      integrate(function(x) exp(-exp(x)) * dnorm(x, mu, sigma), 
                lower = mu - 10*sigma, upper = mu + 10*sigma),
      error = function(e) list(value = NA)
    )
    p0 <- p0_res$value
    
    if (is.na(p0) || p0 >= 1 || p0 < 0) return(1e9)
    
    # --- FIX IS HERE ---
    # Theoretical Moments of the UNTRUNCATED Poisson-Lognormal
    # E[Y] = E[Lambda]
    m1_untrunc <- exp(mu + 0.5 * sigma^2)
    
    # E[Y^2] = E[Lambda] + E[Lambda^2]  <-- The + E[Lambda] was missing before
    m2_untrunc <- m1_untrunc + exp(2 * mu + 2 * sigma^2)
    
    # Theoretical Moments of the ZERO-TRUNCATED distribution
    # E[Z] = E[Y] / (1 - p0)
    mean_zt <- m1_untrunc / (1 - p0)
    
    # E[Z^2] = E[Y^2] / (1 - p0)
    m2_zt <- m2_untrunc / (1 - p0)
    
    # Var(Z) = E[Z^2] - (E[Z])^2
    var_zt <- m2_zt - (mean_zt^2)
    
    # Objective: Squared Error
    return((mean_zt - mean)^2 + (var_zt - var)^2)
  }
  
  # 2. Optimization
  # Initial guesses are critical.
  # We guess sigma=0.5 (moderate dispersion) and approximate mu from log(mean)
  start_par <- c(log(mean) - 0.1, 0.5)
  
  # L-BFGS-B allows bounds to keep sigma positive
  opt <- optim(
    par = start_par, 
    fn = obj_fun, 
    method = "L-BFGS-B",
    lower = c(-Inf, 0.001), 
    upper = c(Inf, Inf)
  )
  
  est_mu <- opt$par[1]
  est_sigma <- opt$par[2]
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat(sprintf("Optimization:\n  Target Mean: %.2f, Target Var: %.2f\n  Found Mu: %.4f, Sigma: %.4f\n", 
                mean, var, est_mu, est_sigma))
  }

  # 3. Generation (Rejection Sampling)
  draws <- numeric(n)
  count <- 0
  
  while (count < n) {
    needed <- n - count
    batch_size <- ceiling(needed * 1.5) 
    
    # Draw Lambda from LogNormal
    lambdas <- rlnorm(batch_size, est_mu, est_sigma)
    
    # Draw Counts from Poisson
    # Note: Using rpois vectorization 
    candidates <- rpois(batch_size, lambdas)
    
    # Filter Zeros
    valid <- candidates[candidates > 0]
    
    n_valid <- length(valid)
    if (n_valid > 0) {
      take <- min(n_valid, needed)
      draws[(count + 1):(count + take)] <- valid[1:take]
      count <- count + take
    }
  }
  
  return(draws)
}
```

```{r}
# --- PARAMETERS ---
target_n    <- 5000
target_mean <- 15
target_var  <- 100 # Try changing this to see the fit adapt

# --- RUN ---
set.seed(123)
sample_vals <- rztpoilog(target_n, target_mean, target_var, verbose = TRUE)

# --- PLOT ---
actual_mean <- mean(sample_vals)
actual_var  <- var(sample_vals)

# Create stats label for top-right corner
label_text <- paste0(
  "Target Mean: ", target_mean, "\n",
  "Actual Mean: ", round(actual_mean, 2), "\n\n",
  "Target Var: ", target_var, "\n",
  "Actual Var: ", round(actual_var, 2)
)

ggplot(data.frame(x = sample_vals), aes(x = x)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)), binwidth = 1, 
                 fill = "#69b3a2", color = "black", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_density(color = "red", linewidth = 1, adjust = 2) +
  annotate("label", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = label_text, 
           hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.1, size = 4, 
           fill = "white", alpha = 0.9, family = "mono") +
  labs(
    title = "Zero-Truncated Poisson-Lognormal Fit",
    subtitle = "Comparing requested moments vs. generated sample moments",
    x = "Value",
    y = "Density"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
ztpln_feasible_vec <- function(mean, var) {
  tibble(
    mean = mean,
    var = var,
    lower_bound = mean - 1,
    feasible = mean > 1 & var >= (mean - 1)
  )
}

ztpln_feasible_vec(seq(1, 3, 0.1), seq(1, 3, 0.1))
```
